fish.note: Grass Pickerel is the subspecies E. a. vermiculatus; iNat may resolve to the species E. americanus (Redfin Pickerel).
Percina caprodes is often called simply Logperch on iNat.
HYBRID: Wiper = White Bass x Striped Bass (Morone chrysops x M. saxatilis). iNaturalist has no clean species taxon for this. Resolve by hand or drop this card.
Most texts say Notropis dorsalis; iNaturalist files this under Ericymba dorsalis. Verify it's the same fish.
Most texts say Acipenser fulvescens; iNaturalist has moved it to Huso fulvescens. Verify it's the same fish.
iNat split Largemouth Bass: M. nigricans is the widespread species; M. salmoides is now Florida Bass. Must resolve to M. nigricans.

herps.note: Most texts say Hyla versicolor; iNaturalist uses Dryophytes versicolor. ALSO visually identical to Cope's Gray Treefrog (D. chrysoscelis) — call is the reliable separator, so watch for misidentified photos. Note iNat also has a 'complex' rank taxon of the same name — pick the species-rank one.
